data: What is the nearest neighbor translation accuracy of the solid green line when the parallel corpus size is 20K?

The solid green line represents FastText (sent). To find its nearest neighbor translation accuracy at a parallel corpus size of 20K, I need to look at the y-axis value where the x-axis intersects with 20K on the horizontal axis. The green line appears to be around 0.75 on the y-axis for this point. Therefore, the nearest neighbor translation accuracy of the solid green line when the parallel corpus size is 20K is approximately 0.75 or 75%.
